title: Trails · Swings, spells and spirals
description: Ribbon trails (src/trails.ts, docs/graphics.md) in a fight frozen in time and stepped frame by frame: Gerard's fist mid-swing and just after contact, a dog lunging, No-ta (the fist in Noísta's red and the stamp streaking down), Cardioide and Análisis Parálisis flying to the party in Matemágico's gold, an ánima waking in three strands and a swap in two, and a comet thrown between fighters.

steps.eval: window.step = frames => { for (let i = 0; i < frames; i++) window.gerard.game.app.fire('update', 1 / 60); }; window.play = (effect, frames, anima = 'noista') => import('/src/battle.ts').then(m => { const g = window.gerard.game; g.app.timeScale = 0; g.effects.clear(); g.setBattle(m.createBattle(2, 3, false, anima), effect); step(frames); }); window.models = () => { const stage = window.gerard.game.app.root.findByName('Escenario de combate'); return stage.children.filter(c => c.enabled && !['Objetivo', 'Marca de tinta', 'Sello No-ta'].includes(c.name)).sort((a, b) => a.getPosition().x - b.getPosition().x); };

steps.caption: A plain attack: Gerard's fist swings an arc of warm light into the blow
At contact: the arc fades into the flash and sparks
A dog lunges: a streak behind its nose
No-ta: the stamp falls, two speed lines streaking behind it
No-ta: Gerard's fist swings in Noísta's red as the stamp comes down
Cardioide: a comet of Matemágico's gold flies to Bernat
Análisis Parálisis: gold to Bernat's head, a strand winding round Gerard
An ánima wakes: three strands of its light wind up round him
A swap (L / R): two strands, quicker

steps.eval: play(undefined, 0).then(() => { const [a, , , d] = models(); const p = a.getPosition(), q = d.getPosition(); window.gerard.game.effects.comet({ x: p.x, y: p.y + 1.2, z: p.z }, { x: q.x, y: q.y + .7, z: q.z }, '#7fc8d8', .45, { arc: 1.2 }); step(16); })

steps.caption: effects.comet: a spell thrown in an arc between fighters
…flaring where it lands as its tail catches up
